description: Two coin pushers at the front, lit bright, with shelves of tarnished pennies leaning over the drop. Behind them a claw machine with a bent finger, four upright cabinets with violet-edged screens, and five more at the back that take a coin and make a noise. Everything is bolted down. A card over the change booth: NO REFUNDS, NO TILTING, NO SITTING ON THE PUSHERS. The third is underlined twice.

window.description: There is no window, because there is no wall. The front of the building is an opening and the weather comes about four feet into the room whenever it feels like it, which is why the first pusher stands on bricks.
window.name: the open front

name: The Penny Drops — The Floor
